draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.35, the 38th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 6th of 35 at WR. He lasted until pick 65, well after his grade rank (38th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Deebo Samuel. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 984 receiving yards in 2023, 13th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns. 22 career games and 6 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: receiving td 0 (13th percentile), receiving yards 79 (15th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 wide receiver who played: 79 receiving yards against a median of 290, below the norm.
